paras.text: The operating system that is used to operate, control and manage a parallel computer system is called parallel processing operating system. A parallel computer system is a computer which has multiple processors that work co-operatively to solve a specific computational problem. The parallel execution can be achieved by executing multiple processes on different processors in parallel. Parallel operating systems are much similar to multiprocessing operating systems.

paras.text: Time-sharing operating systems allows users to share a single processor simultaneously. Each user is allocated resources, CPU, for a particular time slot called time slice. In parallel processing operating systems, various processes are executed simultaneously on multiple processors. In parallel processing operating systems, there is no such scheme used for the allocation of resources (e.g. processor) in which it is shared among multiple processes.

paras.text: A distributed operating system is an operating system that manages a group of independent computers and makes them appear to the users as a single computer.
paras.urdu: ڈسٹری بیوٹڈ آپریٹنگ سسٹم ایسا آپریٹنگ سسٹم ہے جو آزاد کمپیوٹرز کے ایک گروپ کا انتظام کرتا ہے اور انھیں صارفین کو ایک ہی کمپیوٹر کی طرح دکھاتا ہے۔
paras.pashto: وېشل شوی عملیاتي سیسټم داسې عملیاتي سیسټم دی چې د خپلواکو کمپیوټرونو یوه ډله اداره کوي او کاروونکو ته یې د یوه کمپیوټر په څېر ښيي.

paras.text: When independent computers are networked together in such a way to work in a co-operative manner then they give rise to a distributed system. In a distributed environment, for performing a task, the computers communicate with each other and perform operations in such a way that the users do not feel that the computations are taking place on more than one machine. In a distributed environment, the resources should be shared; the processes should be scheduled on different machines, and the communication and synchronization mechanisms should be defined clearly. All these are the duties of a distributed operating system. The distributed operating system hides from the users that where a particular resource is, how the data is accessed, how a resource was moved to a new location and how the error was recovered.

sections.theory:
Multiprogramming Vs Multiprocessing

Multiprogramming is different from multiprocessing in the sense that in multiprogramming multiple programs are processed by a single processor in an interleaved passion giving the impression of being executed simultaneously while in multiprocessing operating systems multiple processors execute more than one programs simultaneously.

g. Parallel processing operating system

The operating system that is used to operate, control and manage a parallel computer system is called parallel processing operating system. A parallel computer system is a computer which has multiple processors that work co-operatively to solve a specific computational problem. The parallel execution can be achieved by executing multiple processes on different processors in parallel. Parallel operating systems are much similar to multiprocessing operating systems.

Parallel computing is used for problems which need many calculations simultaneously. This task is accomplished by dividing the computationally complex and large problems into smaller independent tasks which are executed concurrently on parallel processors.

Parallel processing can be achieved at different levels such as, bit-level, instruction level, data level and task level. The most commonly used parallel processing operating systems are UNIX and Microsoft Windows NT.

Time-sharing Vs parallel processing operating system

Time-sharing operating systems allows users to share a single processor simultaneously. Each user is allocated resources, CPU, for a particular time slot called time slice. In parallel processing operating systems, various processes are executed simultaneously on multiple processors. In parallel processing operating systems, there is no such scheme used for the allocation of resources (e.g. processor) in which it is shared among multiple processes.

h. Distributed operating system

A distributed operating system is an operating system that manages a group of independent computers and makes them appear to the users as a single computer.

When independent computers are networked together in such a way to work in a co-operative manner then they give rise to a distributed system. In a distributed environment, for performing a task, the computers communicate with each other and perform operations in such a way that the users do not feel that the computations are taking place on more than one machine. In a distributed environment, the resources should be shared; the processes should be scheduled on different machines, and the communication and synchronization mechanisms should be defined clearly. All these are the duties of a distributed operating system. The distributed operating system hides from the users that where a particular resource is, how the data is accessed, how a resource was moved to a new location and how the error was recovered.

Advantages of distributed system

Communication and resource sharing is possible which eliminates the need of dedicated resources with each computer system.

The distributed systems are economical in the sense that expensive resources are shared.

The system is reliable because of the availability of multiple machines for performing the task of a failed system.

The system has the potential for incremental growth.

Disadvantages of distributed system

Network connectivity is an essential part of a distributed system which is a difficult and expensive task.

Security and privacy is an issue.

موازي محاسبه د هغو ستونزو لپاره کارول کېږي چې په یو وخت ډېرو محاسبو ته اړتیا لري. دا دنده د محاسبوي پېچلو او لویو ستونزو په کوچنیو خپلواکو دندو وېشلو سره ترسره کېږي چې پر موازي پروسېسرونو په یو وخت اجرا کېږي.

موازي پروسس په بېلابېلو کچو ترلاسه کېدای شي، لکه د بټ کچه، د لارښوونې کچه، د ډېټا کچه او د دندې کچه. تر ټولو ډېر کارېدونکي موازي پروسس عملیاتي سیسټمونه UNIX او Microsoft Windows NT دي.

وخت شریکونکی د موازي پروسس عملیاتي سیسټم په پرتله

وخت شریکونکي عملیاتي سیسټمونه کاروونکو ته اجازه ورکوي چې په یو وخت یو پروسېسر شریک کړي. هر کاروونکي ته سرچینې، یعنې CPU، د یوې ټاکلې وخت برخې لپاره ورکول کېږي چې د وخت برخه (time slice) بلل کېږي. په موازي پروسس عملیاتي سیسټمونو کې بېلابېلې پروسې پر ډېرو پروسېسرونو په یو وخت اجرا کېږي. په موازي پروسس عملیاتي سیسټمونو کې د سرچینو (لکه پروسېسر) د وېش لپاره داسې طرحه نه کارول کېږي چې پکې د ډېرو پروسو ترمنځ شریک شي.

h. وېشل شوی عملیاتي سیسټم

وېشل شوی عملیاتي سیسټم داسې عملیاتي سیسټم دی چې د خپلواکو کمپیوټرونو یوه ډله اداره کوي او کاروونکو ته یې د یوه کمپیوټر په څېر ښيي.

کله چې خپلواک کمپیوټرونه په شبکه کې داسې سره ونښلول شي چې په همکاره توګه کار وکړي، نو یو وېشل شوی سیسټم رامنځته کوي. په وېشل شوي چاپېریال کې د یوې دندې د ترسره کولو لپاره کمپیوټرونه له یو بل سره اړیکه نیسي او عملیې داسې ترسره کوي چې کاروونکي احساس نه کړي چې محاسبې پر یوه زیات ماشین کېږي. په وېشل شوي چاپېریال کې باید سرچینې شریکې وي؛ پروسې باید پر بېلابېلو ماشینونو مهالوېش شي، او د اړیکې او همغږۍ لارې باید روښانه وټاکل شي. دا ټول د وېشل شوي عملیاتي سیسټم دندې دي. وېشل شوی عملیاتي سیسټم له کاروونکو پټوي چې یوه ځانګړې سرچینه چېرته ده، ډېټا ته څنګه لاسرسی کېږي، یوه سرچینه نوي ځای ته څنګه ولېږدول شوه او تېروتنه څنګه سمه شوه.

د وېشل شوي سیسټم ګټې

اړیکه او د سرچینو شریکول شوني دي چې له هر کمپیوټري سیسټم سره د ځانګړو سرچینو اړتیا له منځه وړي.

وېشل شوي سیسټمونه په دې معنا سپما کوونکي دي چې ګرانې سرچینې شریکېږي.

د ناکام سیسټم د دندې د ترسره کولو لپاره د ډېرو ماشینونو د شتون له امله سیسټم باوري دی.

سیسټم د تدریجي ودې وړتیا لري.

د وېشل شوي سیسټم زیانونه

د شبکې نښلون د وېشل شوي سیسټم اړینه برخه ده چې ستونزمنه او ګرانه دنده ده.

امنیت او محرمیت یوه ستونزه ده.

Multiprogramming Vs Multiprocessing

Multiprogramming is different from multiprocessing in the sense that in multiprogramming multiple programs are processed by a single processor in an interleaved passion giving the impression of being executed simultaneously while in multiprocessing operating systems multiple processors execute more than one programs simultaneously.

g. Parallel processing operating system

The operating system that is used to operate, control and manage a parallel computer system is called parallel processing operating system. A parallel computer system is a computer which has multiple processors that work co-operatively to solve a specific computational problem. The parallel execution can be achieved by executing multiple processes on different processors in parallel. Parallel operating systems are much similar to multiprocessing operating systems.

Parallel computing is used for problems which need many calculations simultaneously. This task is accomplished by dividing the computationally complex and large problems into smaller independent tasks which are executed concurrently on parallel processors.

Parallel processing can be achieved at different levels such as, bit-level, instruction level, data level and task level. The most commonly used parallel processing operating systems are UNIX and Microsoft Windows NT.

Time-sharing Vs parallel processing operating system

Time-sharing operating systems allows users to share a single processor simultaneously. Each user is allocated resources, CPU, for a particular time slot called time slice. In parallel processing operating systems, various processes are executed simultaneously on multiple processors. In parallel processing operating systems, there is no such scheme used for the allocation of resources (e.g. processor) in which it is shared among multiple processes.

h. Distributed operating system

A distributed operating system is an operating system that manages a group of independent computers and makes them appear to the users as a single computer.

When independent computers are networked together in such a way to work in a co-operative manner then they give rise to a distributed system. In a distributed environment, for performing a task, the computers communicate with each other and perform operations in such a way that the users do not feel that the computations are taking place on more than one machine. In a distributed environment, the resources should be shared; the processes should be scheduled on different machines, and the communication and synchronization mechanisms should be defined clearly. All these are the duties of a distributed operating system. The distributed operating system hides from the users that where a particular resource is, how the data is accessed, how a resource was moved to a new location and how the error was recovered.

Advantages of distributed system

Communication and resource sharing is possible which eliminates the need of dedicated resources with each computer system.

The distributed systems are economical in the sense that expensive resources are shared.

The system is reliable because of the availability of multiple machines for performing the task of a failed system.

The system has the potential for incremental growth.

Disadvantages of distributed system

Network connectivity is an essential part of a distributed system which is a difficult and expensive task.

Security and privacy is an issue.
